name: Grand Arbiter Leonos
description: The Azorius Grand Arbiter for whom a new statue is approved.

timeline.summary: Relov is turned to stone, and his statue is installed near the main gate and mistaken for one of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
timeline.quote: No one looked long enough to see the uncanny resemblance to the missing Relov or the terror in his unblinking eyes.

timeline.summary: Relov processes paperwork, dismissing Mr. Lapt's application over a spelling error and approving a new statue of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
timeline.quote: Learn to spell, Mr. Lapt, and stop wasting my precious time.

relations.note: He killed Relov's proposal for stricter limits on executions.
relations.quote: his proposal had been killed by Grand Arbiter Leonos a year ago.

pages_say.description: The Azorius Grand Arbiter who killed Relov's proposal to limit executions and whose statue is mistaken for the one of Relov.
The Azorius Grand Arbiter for whom a new statue is approved.
